reachable.description: Upstream answered (any HTTP status counts as reachable).

suggestedId.description: Optional id the provider returned (e.g. GitHub repo id) — null when unknown.

message.description: Provider-specific short status sentence (e.g. `"github: 200 OK"`) for the operator.

description:
The outcome of a probe — does the upstream answer, how fast, what id
would the host suggest for a follow-up create. The `latencyMs`
is measured end-to-end (HTTP request to first response byte) and is
only meaningful when `reachable` is true.
